quests.title: Contingencies

dialogue.t: Hello, Traveler. Please refrain from leaving the city during this time, if you will.
Now, I believe that you've seen those fallen meteorites as well.
For some reason, they've started falling at a greater rate than before, and it's become more dangerous out there in the wild.
All sorts of matters are cropping up within the city, almost more than the Knights can handle. All this, at a time when we'd just discovered Treasure Hoarder activity near the city...
Those fellows would do anything for a little Mora. I fear that they'll try to take advantage of this situation...
If you're willing, Traveler, could you help us chase those thieves off?
This should be a task for the Knights, but I fear that we can't spare the people to settle this matter. Can you help us?

dialogue.sit: The Treasure Hoarders aren't scared of the meteorites?

dialogue.t: You have my thanks. I'm sorry, I know it's not the best look for us to be asking you to help us in these circumstances.
How do you do, Honorary Knight? Please, do your utmost to remain within the city limits during this time.
Now, I believe that you've seen those fallen meteorites as well.
For some reason, they've started falling at a greater rate than before, and it's become more dangerous out there in the wild.
All sorts of matters are cropping up within the city, almost more than the Knights can handle. All this, at a time when we'd just discovered Treasure Hoarder activity near the city...
Those fellows would do anything for a little Mora. I fear that they'll try to take advantage of this situation...
If you're willing, Traveler, could you help us chase those thieves off?

dialogue.sit: Aren't the Treasure Hoarders scared of the meteorites?

dialogue.t: Spoken well, Honorary Knight. I'll leave it in your able hands.
I suppose it can be considered some small consolation that no meteorites have come down within the city walls.
Have you succeeded in beating back those Treasure Hoarders?
Wonderful. You've been a great help.
Hopefully, those Treasure Hoarders will take a hint from this lesson and stop eyeing Mondstadt up.

dialogue.sit: Well then, if there's nothing else...

dialogue.t: Um, so, please hold on a moment... There is something else I need your help with.
In truth, we've received a plenitude of reports about abnormal monsters during this period.
These reports mention that the meteorites have caused the monsters to become especially aggressive.
The city's defenses are sufficiently stalwart, so there's no reason to worry there. But one such meteorite has landed right beside Springvale...
Springvale is home to many hunters, and we've sent knights to reinforce them, but the terrain is truly difficult to police.
If any monsters were to enter the town, things could get disastrous...
Could you head over to Springvale and help us investigate the status of the monsters there?

dialogue.sit: What's the situation over in Springvale?

dialogue.t: I'll leave it in your capable hands, then. I will do what I can to send some knights over to assist you.
Meteorites, monsters and the Treasure Hoarders. It's really pouring, isn't it...
Aaaah! D—Don't come any...
Eh? Y—You're not a monster. Wh—Who are you?

dialogue.sit: What's the status on those monsters?

dialogue.t: The monsters? What is there to ask? I was just running from them, that's what!
They were right there, a whole bunch of them, looking like they might attack the town.
If I hadn't run so fast, I'd have been a goner...
Right next to the town. A few steps around the corner and you'll see them.
You should get to shelter as well. I'll rest here for a while, and then I'll go warn everyone in town.
I have to warn everyone...
Huh? It's you, again? What were you doing this whole time?
Defeating all the... What? Just you?

dialogue.sit: You can go check it out.

dialogue.t: Ugh, I daren't look. If they see me, I'd be done for!
I'll just report what you've said to the Knights — never mind if it's true or not.
Th—They'll have some way to check if you've beaten all those monsters, I'm sure.
How's the situation?
That's great... I was honestly worried that we might not be able to spare anyone to help out.
Thank you so much. You've really helped us out this time. Please take these as a token of our esteem.
*sigh* Meteorites, monsters... I can only hope that nothing truly messy happens.
Did you really defeat all those monsters by yourself?
If that's so, you're really strong. Better than the Knights of Favonius, even.

quests.description: Huffman is currently so busy with matters concerning the fallen meteorites, that he barely has time for anything else…
